cues: Put the two speeches side by side.
Evening, over drinks, against the next day, sober.
The East that only gives, against a child who can neither give nor take.
Peace and smiles, against poverty and helplessness.
History from books, against the pulse of reality.
The Buddha's eyes, against the eyes of a paralysed boy.
